game: You Have to Win the Game

release-0.0.3.description: Client is no longer restricted to connecting only on startup.
release-0.0.3.title: v0.0.3

release-0.1.0.description:
1st major update.

Adds the option to split the Spider Gloves into left and right versions.

Adds the option to include 3 one-time traps: a Stop Jumping Trap, a Secret Room Trap, and a Lose The Game.

General logic and client improvements.
release-0.1.0.title: v0.1.0

release-0.2.0.description:
Added an option to shuffle an "Unlock Teleporters" item that restricts access to 3 of the main teleporters.

Added an option to enable harder logic. Currently it only affects 1 location, but I may put more stuff here in the future.

Updated Deathlink message to say where the player died.

More logic changes.

Added a safeguard in the client to stop the player from sending checks if the Archipelago map mod isn't used.

Added a teleporter near the secret cat level to prevent softlocking.
release-0.2.0.title: v0.2.0

release-0.2.1.description:
Adds a teleporter in "yeah but why u jelly tho".

Changes the "harder_logic_difficulty" option to "logic difficulty" because I found something thats harder than I want hard to be.

Also fixed the option issues when generating an output.
release-0.2.1.title: v0.2.1

release-0.3.0.description:
New YAML Options
- Roomsanity
- Freeze trap
- Fast trap
- Extra roadblocks
- Local fill

APWorld Changes
- A complete refactor of all the logic.
- Replaced some anti-softlock measures in the map with the ability to warp to the starting room from anywhere.
    - Crouch for 5 seconds to trigger this.
- Split YAML options into OptionGroups
- Yaml-less UT integration (requires [Universal Tracker](https://github.com/FarisTheAncient/Archipelago/releases?q=Tracker))

Bugs Fixed
- Receiving a Stop Jumping Trap after a Secret Room Trap causes it to not work.
- Getting a Secret Room Trap can sometimes cause the player to go out of bounds when returning.
- DeathLink message passes the lambda function instead of the actual value.
- DeathLink message states the entire location name of the room.
- You cannot access "Hardcore Prawn - Treasure" without unlocking teleporters.
release-0.3.0.title: v0.3.0

release-0.4.0.description:
New YAML Options
- Bellsanity
   - For those who want roomsanity but thought that it was too bloated. 
   
APWorld Changes
- Lots of logic clean up.
- Client improvements, specifically relating to caching sending locations so I'm (hopefully) not spamming the server every loop.

Bugs Fixed
- Uncapitalized the "the" in Lose the Game for consistency.
release-0.4.0.title: v0.4.0

release-0.5.0.description:
APWorld Changes
- Changed include_extra_roadblocks to be an OptionSet.
- Added toggleable DeathLink behavior to either restart to checkpoint or go to the starting room.
- Added configurable reset timer for when you are softlocked.
- Traps are now generated based on the percentage of filler and corresponding weights.
    - Some traps can have their length adjusted per slot.
- Logic tweaks.
- Added a Playable Cat DLC* item that turns you into a cat for 9 lives.

Bugs Fixed
- Lose the Game traps work again.
- DeathLink messages will show up correctly.
release-0.5.0.title: v0.5.0

release-0.5.1.description:
HOTFIXES
Because rewriting all of my item receive stuff broke more than I thought.

- Fixed goaling. (im really not proud of this one)
- Fixed a softlock with receiving a Secret Room Trap while in the secret room.
- Fixed being unable to jump when receiving a Stop Jumping Trap while already having one active.
release-0.5.1.title: v0.5.1

release-0.5.2.description:
Fixed bugs relating to closing and reopening the client. Notably...
* Losing access to gated off areas upon exiting.
* Treasure locations not being sent out instantly upon re-connection.
release-0.5.2.title: v0.5.2

release-1.0.0.description:
First feature-complete build.

APWorld Changes
- Added Password Randomization
- Updated deathlink_behavior's option names to be clearer.
- Updated the default local_nothing_percentage option and added a minimum of 50%.
- Added more logic for Hard difficulty.
- Added more stuff to the documentation page.

Client Changes
- Added a "Password" tab.
- Fixed a ton of errors that occurred when using the Disconnect button on the client.
- Made impossible to access the Mineshaft region without unlocking it first by spamming down.
- Client no longer spams the server when the game has been beaten.
release-1.0.0.title: v1.0.0

Just client changes, it is backwards compatible.
release-1.0.1.title: v1.0.1
